senses.gloss: f. (ארך, v. עַרְכִי; an adaptation of ἀρχή, cmp. אַרְכָן) term of office, office, court of elders.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> whoever was signed as a witness <he>בא׳ ישנה וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:5">Kidd. IV, 5</cite> <cite ref="P01381"><he>ערכי</he></cite> q. v.) in the old court of Zepphoris.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:4:3">Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מעלה לאַרְכִיָים</he> he (the gentile) takes the deed to their (gentile) office for recording. Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵈ top.—
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:7">Ruth R. to I, 3</cite> <he>א׳ של בנך דוחקת</he> the time of thy son’s accession to office presses.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:5">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>הגיע א׳ וכ׳</he> surrender thy office to Joshua.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:5">Ib.</cite> a prefect <he>שהיה בא׳ שלו</he> who was in his office; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="A03144"><he>אַרְכִיּוֹת</he></cite>. Ruth. R. l. c. <he>א׳ א׳ הן</he> the terms of office are predestined (cmp.
<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:9">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ואין מלכות וכ׳</he>). [<cite ref="P01379"><he>עַרְכָאוֹת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01381"><he>עַרְכִי</he></cite>.]
